title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ComputeServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ComputeServiceOffering. A digital service available for order and offering computational capabilities. Subclass of InfrastructureServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InfrastructureServiceOffering model and not repeated here. The source ontology marks this class as abstract, not intended for direct instantiation; concrete subtypes (e.g. BareMetalServiceOffering, VirtualMachineServiceOffering, ContainerServiceOffering, ComputeFunctionServiceOffering) are modeled as their own entities.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ComputeServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tenantSeparation.description: Property. How compute resources of different tenants are separated. Default value 'hw-virtualized'. Controlled-vocabulary value (TenantSeparation), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
